title: Insurer Program Agreements Labor and Paint Materials Rate Schedule
content:
Repairs on an insurer's claims under the Insurer Program Agreements are rated by the hour at the figures below, fixed by the tier of the insurer's agreement. Six hourly figures make up the schedule, each in US dollars per hour:

- **Body labor rate** on the insurer's repairs.
- **Refinish labor rate**.
- **Frame and structural steel labor rate**.
- **Mechanical and electrical labor rate**.
- **Aluminum structural labor rate**.
- **Paint and materials**, charged per refinish labor hour.

## Schedule of hourly rates (USD per hour)

| Agreement tier | Body | Refinish | Frame and structural steel | Mechanical and electrical | Aluminum structural | Paint and materials per refinish hour |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network Referral Agreement | 64.00 | 64.00 | 82.00 | 115.00 | 125.00 | 42.00 |
| Select Direct Repair Agreement | 62.00 | 62.00 | 80.00 | 110.00 | 120.00 | 41.00 |
| Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | 61.00 | 61.00 | 78.00 | 108.00 | 118.00 | 40.00 |
| Premier Direct Repair Agreement | 60.00 | 60.00 | 76.00 | 105.00 | 115.00 | 39.00 |
| Managed Repair Program Agreement | 59.00 | 59.00 | 75.00 | 104.00 | 112.00 | 38.50 |
| Enterprise Master Services Agreement | 58.00 | 58.00 | 74.00 | 102.00 | 110.00 | 38.00 |

## Notes on reading the schedule

- Each row is one agreement tier; the rate that applies is the one in the row of the tier the insurer's agreement holds.
- Body and refinish labor carry the same hourly figure within every tier.
- Paint and materials is not an hourly labor rate of its own: it is a dollar figure for each refinish labor hour, so it follows the refinish hours on the repair, not the body, frame, mechanical or aluminum hours.

## Illustration (hypothetical repair)

A hypothetical repair under a Premier Direct Repair Agreement records 3.0 refinish labor hours. Refinish labor is 3.0 hours multiplied by 60.00, or 180.00; paint and materials is 3.0 refinish hours multiplied by 39.00, or 117.00. The hours are invented for the illustration; only the two hourly figures come from the schedule.

## Questions on the schedule

**Which figure applies to structural work on an aluminum-bodied vehicle?** The aluminum structural labor rate of the agreement's tier, for example 112.00 per hour under a Managed Repair Program Agreement.

**Which figure applies to structural steel?** The frame and structural steel labor rate, for example 80.00 per hour under a Select Direct Repair Agreement.

**Is electrical work rated with mechanical work?** Yes; the schedule carries one mechanical and electrical labor rate per tier.
